v1.description: Deterministic rule-based segmenter covering numbered clauses, section numbering, and headings.

v2_learned_segmenter.notes: Real BIO model was not trained due to compute limitations. Currently functions as naive heuristic sentence splitter.

evaluation_harness.notes: Real evaluation metrics are unverified because no genuine held-out labeled set was available from Prompt 2. Fixture is a unit test.

commands.purpose: Fetched Prompt 2 EDGAR documents which were git-ignored
Verified segmentation logic and no regressions

metrics.metric: V1 SEC EDGAR Processing Success Rate

metrics.provenance: SYNTHETIC GOLD for demonstration purposes (stored in fixtures/segmentation_v1_metrics.json)

known_gaps: Prompt 2 handoff artifacts were missing in the repo. This was explicitly handled.
V2 BIO Tagger is only a heuristic inference implementation; no CRF/Transformer training occurred due to environment/time limits.
Gold standard labels for V1 evaluation were synthetically generated for demonstration to prove harness functionality.
starting_point_for_prompt_4: Prompt 4 can proceed by using `src.segmentation.factory.get_segmenter('v1')` to obtain a functional, robust rule-based clause segmenter that conforms to the `ClauseRecord` schema.
